Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. It was a U1 (not a U2), so it was only layed out once.
And since Jyhad went through only one (very large) printing, all the
Jyhad-backed versions look the same.

Similarly, Spawning Pool (an R1) is a master card with a minion card
background (they only had two backgrounds back then).
